description: This file contains functions and variables related to NAND storage management and firmware upgrading procedures for OpenWrt devices. It includes operations such as locating UBI volumes, creating/removing volumes, writing images to flash, and verifying upgrade files.

methods.name: ubi_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node for a UBI volume based on the device information found in the specified directory.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds the UBI volume basename in sysfs corresponding to a given UBI device and volume name.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Locates the UBI device name associated with a given partition by matching MTD index.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a specified file at an optional offset.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the magic of a NAND image to determine its format.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the magic of a tar archive to determine its format.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if the file is gzip compressed based on magic bytes.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores the system configuration from a backup into the root filesystem stored in ubifs.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes and unmounts the UBI block device associated with a given volume.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI volume to the MTD device, formatting if necessary, and creates volume if missing.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI device from its MTD partition and cleans up associated UBI volumes.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for firmware upgrade, creating or resizing volumes as needed.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Writes a ubinized UBI image to the NAND partition.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Flashes a UBIFS image onto the UBI root filesystem volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Uploads a FIT image to the UBI kernel volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Extracts and flashes images contained in a tar archive onto appropriate MTD/UBI partitions/volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of a gzip compressed file.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity of a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Determines file type and performs the appropriate flash upgrade (UBI, UBIFS, FIT, tar).

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores system configuration from a backup archive.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing an upgrade from a given file, handling success and failure procedures.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Handles actions after a successful upgrade, including restoring configs, unmounting, and rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles actions after a failed upgrade, including rebooting.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Validates whether the provided upgrade file is compatible with the current platform.
